lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦地跳过草地。
lines.en: I hop across the grass.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵跟着一跳一跳。
lines.en: My ears bounce with each hop.
I land on leaves and they rustle.
I stop and sniff the grass roots.

lines.zh: 我绕着一棵树转了一圈。
lines.en: I hop once around a tree.
There's a glint on my back.

lines.zh: 我蹦到石头上，又跳下来。
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and off again.
I poke my ears through the blades.

lines.zh: 我的后腿一蹬，就出去了。
lines.en: One push of my hind legs and I'm off.
I hop slowly along the path.
My tail flips behind me.

lines.zh: 我跳到阳光照到的那片草上。
lines.en: I hop onto the sunlit grass.
I sniff. Not food.
I hop back a little.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌很轻，落下去没声。
lines.en: My feet are light; they land without sound.

lines.zh: 我在草丛边上犹豫了一下。
lines.en: I hesitate at the edge of the grass.
I crouch, ears turning.
I chew a tender leaf.

lines.zh: 我耳朵贴着地，听远处的脚步。
lines.en: Ear to the ground, I listen for far-off steps.
A sound. I raise my head.
The sun warms my ears.
I put my forepaws together.

lines.zh: 我缓缓地闭上又睁开眼。
lines.en: I close my eyes slowly and open them.
This meadow is safe.
I listen to insects crawling.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖耳朵上的露水。
lines.en: I shake the dew from my ears.
I turn a circle in place.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩成一个小球。
lines.en: I tuck into a small ball.
A bird calls in the distance.
I wait for this gust to pass.
My whiskers brush the grass.

lines.zh: 耳根发痒，我拿后腿蹭了蹭。
lines.en: My ear itches, so I rub it with a hind leg.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们一样高了。
lines.en: You crouch, and we're the same height.
I look up at you, ears up.
Hold still. Let me sniff first.

lines.zh: 我背上有块亮亮的东西。
lines.en: There's something bright on my back.
You came near, and my ears twitched.
I don't much like being picked up.

lines.zh: 你的鞋带松了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your lace is untied. I noticed.
I hop one small step toward you.

lines.zh: 这里的人不多，你算一个。
lines.en: Not many people here. You're one.
I'm cooling off in your shadow.
I tilt my head to hear you.
Would you like to touch my ears?
It hurts; I jump away.
My ears have drooped.
I huddle in the grass, trembling.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，耳朵贴着头。
lines.en: I ball up, ears pressed to my skull.
The glint on my back has dimmed.
I back half a step, then another.
My nose twitches.
The skin of my nose is scraped.
That hurt more than I expected.
I need to get back to my nest.
Those green leaves look good.

lines.zh: 你把胡萝卜举起来了吗。
lines.en: Have you raised a carrot?
I hop over slowly.

lines.zh: 这点味道，让我耳朵都直了。
lines.en: That smell makes my ears stand straight.

lines.zh: 我围着你放下的东西转圈。
lines.en: I circle what you set down.
If you crouch, I'll dare come.

lines.zh: 你手心里的东西，闻着甜。
lines.en: What's in your palm smells sweet.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我很快就吃完。
lines.en: I'll finish this quickly.

lines.zh: 我站起来，鼻尖够到你手指。
lines.en: I stand up, nose reaching your fingers.
Stay still and I'll come closer.
My nose keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 这味道，是从你口袋里来的。
lines.en: The smell comes from your pocket.

lines.zh: 最后一口，我保证不回头。
lines.en: One last bite, I promise not to look back.

lines.zh: 你退开一步，我才敢靠近。
lines.en: Step back and I'll dare come closer.
I hop a circle around it.
I'll remember you fed me.
You bump me and I bounce away.
I hop half a step aside.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵蹭到你的手指。
lines.en: My ear brushed against your fingers.
Don't push; I'm fragile.
We collide and grass shakes.
You've pinned my shadow down.
I hop behind your feet.
That rolled me half a turn.
I touch you and hop off at once.
Too close; I'm nervous.

lines.zh: 另一只从草丛里跳出来。
lines.en: Another hops out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我们耳朵碰着耳朵，蹲在一起。
lines.en: Ears touching, we squat side by side.
Its ears are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 它挖洞，我就在旁边看着。
lines.en: It digs, and I watch from beside it.

lines.zh: 它背上的亮光比我的亮。
lines.en: The glint on its back is brighter.
We gnaw the same leaf.

lines.zh: 草地上的影子，叠成一个。
lines.en: Our shadows on the grass merge into one.
In the grass there are only the two of us.
It rests its head against me.

lines.zh: 以后这片草地有两个了。
lines.en: There'll be two of us in this meadow.

lines.zh: 我把亮片藏在落叶底下。
lines.en: I hide the shiny bit under fallen leaves.
I hug it with both forepaws.
I bury it in the grass.

lines.zh: 紫水晶的碎片，我叼得住。
lines.en: I can carry a shard of amethyst.
The shiny thing rolls into the grass; I chase.
I sniff. Can't eat it.
I carry it to my nest.
It's mine. Don't grab it.
It's a bit heavy; I drag it.

lines.zh: 我的毛里，可能藏着一颗钻石。
lines.en: There might be a diamond in my fur.
Ears flat, I back away.
I spin around fast.
My ears have shot up.
You're at the edge of my nest.
I stepped back, but didn't run.
I was in this meadow first.
Hind legs coiled, ready to spring.
I'm ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 耳朵贴平，我后腿蹬进了土。
lines.en: Ears flat, I dig my hind legs into the soil.
You're not a rabbit; you're far too big.
Do you have a net or a rope?
You move, and I hop.

lines.zh: 我躲进灌木，只露一只耳朵。
lines.en: I duck into the bush, one ear showing.
My ears keep listening.
You step forward; I go sideways.
I know this meadow.
A little more room is all I need.

lines.zh: 我一只一只数你的落脚点。
lines.en: I count each place your feet land.
The grass has many paths.
I won't go far. Just nearby.
A hind kick throws up sand.

lines.zh: 我用后腿蹬了你的手指。
lines.en: I kick your fingers with my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的脚，弹了回去。
lines.en: I hit your foot and bounce back.
You pull back, and I hide at once.
I nip your shoelace.
I hop up and hit your knee.
I land and hop a few paces.
You caught nothing at all.
Gems are set in my fur.
I've hidden in the grass.
The grass parts and I show.

lines.zh: 森林里多了一个小小的影子。
lines.en: A small shadow joins the forest.
Out from under the roots.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵上的露水抖掉。
lines.en: I flick the dew off my ears.
I settle on a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我从草垛下钻出来，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: I slip out from under the hay and shake.
A light shifts on my back.
I hop twice to get my bearings.
I settle down low.
I raise my head and test the wind.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我吓得直跳。
lines.en: Fire singes my fur and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，摔得转了圈。
lines.en: I fall off a stone and land spinning.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我挣着往上。
lines.en: Water in my nose; I struggle up.
The blast flings me into the grass.
An arrow clips a tuft of my fur.
That spell holds me still.
Hungry too long; I can't hop.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: Thunder cracks and I freeze.

lines.zh: 草地消失，我蹬不到东西。
lines.en: The grass is gone; my feet find nothing.
